-4.description: Giant elliptical. Sharp central profile and very extended low surface brightness halo

-3.description: Lenticular. Dominant bulge, no sign of structure in disk nor dust

-2.description: Lenticular. Some structure in disk but no arms, low amounts of dust

-1.description: Lenticular. Clear structure in disk but no arms, thin dust lanes

0.description: Spiral. Very tightly wound arms, very prominent bulge, low amounts of dust

1.description: Spiral. Tightly wound arms, very prominent bulge, low amounts of dust

2.description: Spiral. Quite tightly wound arms, prominent bulge, low amounts of dust

3.description: Spiral. Quite tightly wound arms, prominent bulge, strong dust lanes

4.description: Spiral. Quite loosely wound arms, medium bulge, dust lanes

5.description: Spiral. Grand design spiral, fairly weak bulge, dust lanes

6.description: Spiral. Loosely wound and weak arms, weak bulge, scattered dust

7.description: Spiral. Loosely wound and very weak arms, weak bulge, scattered dust

8.description: Spiral. Very loosely wound arms, very weak bulge, low amounts of dust

9.description: Spiral. Some indication of spiral arms, very weak bulge, low amounts of dust

10.description: Irregular including Magellanic and non-Magellanic types. No arms, no bulge. Irregular profile. Low surface brightness. May host a bar

11.description: Dwarf spheroidal/elliptical. Regular low-surface-brightness profile with no spiral arms. May contain a compact nucleus. LEDA extension of the standard Hubble sequence
